claims.observational_scope: Fixed selected architecture and activation, fixed optimizer and stopping recipe; no convergence rate or universal loss superiority claim.
claims.replicate_policy: All 100 repetitions retained, including valid high-error fits.

computation_cost.timing_scope: fit_ratio_mlp training, validation, early stopping, checkpoint restore; excludes data, initialization, evaluation, calibration, IO, queueing; untimed warmup first
computation_cost.model_exactness_note: Root auditing original/replay model hashes; this check recomputes aggregate arithmetic and checks record metadata.

additional_full_fit_reread.scope: Extra current reread of every original fitted file; distinct from the successful complete checks performed by the finished report jobs.
